result_summary.title: Duplicate account creation via SSO Integration Module
result_summary.description: During our testing in the ME production environment, we noticed that the SSO Integration Module is creating duplicate accounts instead of linking to existing ones. This happens when a user logs in. No business impact yet as it was caught during testing, but we need to know why this is happening to avoid it in live user flows.
